# onetouchswitch (static comparison app)

> Static-only UK broadband comparison for onetouchswitch.com. It runs on GitHub Pages with client-side JS: OS Code-Point Open postcodes as static chunks, manual address, a versioned catalogue of UK broadband offers researched from provider pages (each with source URL, retrieved date, reviewer Ismail Malik; needs_review cleared on live v2), a deterministic contract-cost engine in the browser, guides with search, saved comparisons in localStorage, in-browser PDF bill reading, and offline support. It has no runtime server or third-party API, and makes no orderability claims.

## App and static API
- [App](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/)
- [API index](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/index.json)
- [Postcode file example HU1](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/postcode/HU1.json)
- [Providers](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/providers.json)
- [Approved handoff links](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/handoff.json)
- [Published offers](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/catalogue/current.json)
- [Guides index](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/api/v1/guides/index.json)
- [Engine (ESM)](https://blockchains.github.io/onetouchswitch/engine/v1/ots-engine.mjs)
